verdict.rationale: MailerSend's own docs say content can be personalized with merge fields and conditional logic, and a templates API supports create, fetch, update and delete. That covers part of the story, but the evidence is a single thin marketing-style line with no documented templating syntax. Missing for 10: a documented templating language specification, loop/iteration support, preview or test-render before sending, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can personalize emails with a documented templating language — merge fields, conditionals, loops — and preview or test-render a template before sending

citations.quote: Personalize content with merge fields and conditional logic.
Create, fetch, update, and delete single templates or a list of templates.
